## Court atlas — mongolian-courts-v1.jpg
Asset type: three-column sprite atlas of playing-card court illustrations for a Mongolian card game. Landscape 3:2 canvas divided into EXACTLY THREE equal columns, no gaps. Each column is a full-bleed vertical rectangular ornamental playing-card illustration, flat traditional engraved ink illustration in deep navy, vermilion, ochre gold and warm ivory. LEFT column: Mongolian queen in ornate traditional headdress and red/navy embroidered deel. MIDDLE column: Mongolian king with beard and royal hat in blue/gold deel. RIGHT column: young Mongolian jack warrior in traditional cap, red/gold deel. Every panel double-headed rotationally symmetric like authentic French playing cards: upright bust above, identical inverted bust below, joined at waist center. Intricate flat linework, elegant faces, tapestry pattern, premium traditional deck design. Crisp straight rectangular panels. NO text, letters, numbers, suits, card corners, rounded card outline, UI or shadows. Panel art only, art reaches all edges. Each panel independently fits a narrow 1:2 rectangle.
